features.name: Guest-first AI chat
features.description: Visitors can stream a plain-text conversation without login or a client API key.

features.name: Private Gemini generation endpoint
features.description: A Worker holds the Gemini key, validates requests, and reports free-tier quota exhaustion without paid fallback.

features.name: Optional Google sign-in
features.description: Visitors can chat first, then sign in; auth failures leave the guest conversation available.

features.name: Separate saved conversations
features.description: Firestore stores account-owned chats; guest import is idempotent and does not replace existing history.

features.name: Admin usage and performance view
features.description: Review service use and performance after real traffic justifies monitoring work.
